events_limited_time.statement: Players crave fresh, time-sensitive content that creates excitement and urgency in their gaming routine.
events_limited_time.player_motivation: Fear of missing out drives engagement and creates memorable gaming moments

battle_pass.statement: Players want clear, achievable progression goals with both free and premium rewards to maintain long-term engagement.
battle_pass.player_motivation: Structured progression satisfies achievement needs and justifies time investment

dynamic_pricing.statement: Players desire personalized offers that feel valuable and relevant to their spending patterns and gameplay style.
dynamic_pricing.player_motivation: Feeling of getting a good deal while supporting favorite games

social_guilds.statement: Players seek meaningful social connections and shared achievements within their gaming communities.
social_guilds.player_motivation: Belonging, teamwork, and social status drive long-term commitment

energy_optimization.statement: Players want controlled play sessions that respect their time while maintaining engagement momentum.
energy_optimization.player_motivation: Balanced gameplay that prevents burnout while encouraging regular return
